thread:
Priya Nair: quick thread to align on Q2 roadmap for Reserved Capacity—focus: autoscale policy v2, hard isolation lanes, and burst billing. want a short list of commit items and launch criteria by EOD tuesday.
Samir Patel: +1. customers keep pushing for predictable tail latencies under burst. we should define SLA targets and what triggers fallback to shared pools.
Zoe Kim: agree. proposal: p95 < 120ms for text-gen at committed throughput, p99 < 400ms. burst allowed up to 2x committed for 10 mins, then auto-fallback.
Miguel Torres: that seems reasonable. need to call out cost model: bursts should be billed at premium + reserve burn rate. sales asked for clear contract language.
Alice Chen: from infra perspective, implementing hard isolation (dedicated lane) means we need node-level placement and isolation flags in the scheduler. timeline estimate: 6w for core changes + 2w for e2e tests.
Priya Nair: ok. scope negotiation: must-have for GA: autoscale policy engine, SLA metering, billing labels for burst. nice-to-have: per-customer UI controls for max-burst and soft-fallback toggles.
Samir Patel: question: do we expose policy DSL or GUI only? exposing DSL allows platform teams to automate. but increases API surface.
Zoe Kim: recommend both, but v1 CLI/DSL minimal. UI for ops later. keep rollout tiny initial surface.
Miguel Torres: customers A & B asked for an escape hatch — ability to pin models to customer lanes during incidents. should we include pinning in v1?
Alice Chen: pinning is heavier. can be a canary feature gated behind dedicated rollout. prefer post-GA unless we compress timeline.
Priya Nair: decision idea: ship v1 with pinning as "opt-in beta" behind feature flag and limited to enterprise tenants. that satisfies sales while keeping core scope bounded.
Samir Patel: sounds like a good compromise. add canary plan: 3 customers, floor capacity for 48h, then expand.
Zoe Kim: for launch criteria, propose: 1) SLAs validated on synthetic workload + two customer betas, 2) billing labels populated and reconciled with finance, 3) monitoring dashboards + alerting for p95/p99 and burst exhaust events, 4) rollback path documented.
Priya Nair: I'll draft OKR alignment: Objective - "Predictable reserved capacity for enterprise apps" Key results: KR1: reduce p99 tail variance by 30% for reserved tenants; KR2: enable burst billing accuracy to 98% reconciliation; KR3: onboard 3 enterprise customers to GA lanes.
Miguel Torres: resource ask: eng runtime needs 1 SWE + 0.5 infra support FTE for 8w. can we prioritize headcount or shift sprint?
Alice Chen: we can reassign 0.5 from infra-scaling team for Q2 sprint 2, but full 1 SWE needs approval.
Samir Patel: risks: increased unit cost due to reserved slack, scheduler complexity causing regressions in non-reserved workloads. add risk mitigation: stress tests, perf budgets, and traffic shaping.
Priya Nair: noted. action items: 1) Priya to circulate a trimmed scope doc by tomorrow; 2) Samir + Alice to produce perf cost tradeoff doc (2p) by end of week; 3) Miguel to draft customer-facing contract language for burst + isolation; 4) Zoe to define monitoring/alerts and dashboard mocks. owners tagged.
Miguel Torres: ping @deploy-bot — schedule weekly canary channel for beta customers?
deploy-bot: scheduled: reserved-capacity-beta-weekly at 2026-04-02T15:00Z.
Zoe Kim: quick config snippet for autoscale policy prototype:
```
policy:
  type: reserved-v2
  target_rps: 2000
  burst_multiplier: 2
  burst_window: 10m
  fallback_policy: shared_fallback
  isolation: hard | soft
  billing_label: "reserved.burst.premium"
```
Samir Patel: looks good. we should version the policy schema (v1 -> v2) and include migration notes.
Priya Nair: final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to owners & actions, or drop dissent inline. will lock in roadmap doc once I get sign-offs.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Zoe Kim: :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: thanks team — will send follow-up doc and calendar invites.
